job_location: Austin, TX or New York, NY

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Use GitHub-based workflows to maintain clean, version-controlled analytics code.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour — 'robust, scalable analytics solutions' and clean version-controlled code are the only quality-vs-speed signals present, and the JD contains no velocity or shipping-pace language at all.
evidence.domain_risk: Setpoint provides critical infrastructure for relationships between the world's largest banks, credit funds and capital markets counterparties.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: High — the data products are external, customer-facing outputs in asset-backed lending, where the platform 'automates critical calculations and compliance reporting'.
evidence.collaboration_width: engineering; product; implementation teams; clients (asset managers, business owners, technical stakeholders)
evidence.data_team_maturity: you will be reporting into our Head of Analytics and partnering closely with engineering, product, and implementation teams to build and maintain the data infrastructure that powers our products
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Mid — an analytics function with a Head of Analytics and an existing Python/dbt/SQL data infrastructure is in place, but this is a Series B company with no specialised data sub-teams described.
evidence.jd_authorship: Own end-to-end implementations for the data products for our external customers.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: hiring_manager — the bullets name the actual stack, the GitHub-based workflow and the external-customer delivery model, making the day-to-day legible.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Collaborate with engineering to drive the roadmap for the data products.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Product — the work centres on external data products, prototyping additions to the product suite and driving the product roadmap with engineering and product teams.
evidence.autonomy_level: Own end-to-end implementations for the data products for our external customers ... You look beyond the immediate task to anticipate analytics capabilities needed for future growth.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Strategic — the role owns implementations end to end, prototypes new products and helps drive the data-product roadmap.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: None — the JD contains no AI, ML or coding-assistant language anywhere.
evidence.testing_framing: Use GitHub-based workflows to maintain clean, version-controlled analytics code.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Absent — version control is the only engineering-hygiene practice named; no testing, data contract, observability or data-quality practice appears anywhere in the JD.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Setpoint's technology makes warehouse transactions instant and error free.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Moderate — trust and compliance appear in the company description, but the role's own responsibilities are framed entirely in build-and-deliver terms with no risk register.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Prototype new data products to add to our product suite.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Mixed — prototyping new data products sits alongside building and maintaining existing pipelines, models and dashboards.
evidence.work_arrangement: We have offices in Austin, TX, New York City, NY, and Salt Lake City, UT with hybrid roles based in these locations and an expectation of two days a week in office (Tuesdays and Thursdays).
evidence.loss_aversion: 'We're building trust in this system of credit' — trust framing sits in the company description rather than in the role's own responsibilities.
